tags: Waren oder Dienstleistungen für weniger Geld verkaufen

examples.text: „The grocery discounters are the ones who are making life difficult for bakers,“ he [Reinald Wolf, editor of 'Allgemeine Bäcker Zeitung'] told Deutsche Welle. „They just undercut prices, and bakers can't match them.“

examples.text: It [the price-matching guarantee] is an anti-competitive tactic that warns competitors not to attempt to steal market share by undercutting prices.
